Indian Fashion Designer Masaba Gupta Showcases Bridal Collection at India Couture Week

Masaba Gupta debuted her bridal collection at India Couture Week 2026, while JJ Valaya unveiled his Autumn/Winter showcase. The event took place on February 10-14, 2026, at the NSCI Dome in Mumbai. Masaba Gupta's collection featured traditional Indian designs with modern twists. JJ Valaya showcased a mix of contemporary and vintage elements in his Autumn/Winter collection. The event was attended by fashion enthusiasts and industry professionals.
